download_model: download the pretrained polyencoder retrieval model fine-tuned on BlendedSkillTalk to a given datapath
run_download: run the download function to fetch the multi_task_bst_tuned model archive to a local directory
review_download: review the download function that fetches the v1.0 tar.gz model for the BlendedSkillTalk task
summarize_download: summarize the download function which uses parlai core build_data to retrieve the model
test_download: test the download function by passing a datapath and verifying the model archive is retrieved
